name: Soybean Crush Spread (GPM)
description: Soybean crush spread dashboard using the standard CBOT board crush formula. GPM ($/bushel) = ZL (cents/lb) × 0.11 + ZM ($/short ton) × 0.022 − ZS (cents/bushel) × 0.01. Conversion factors: 11 lbs soy oil per bushel (ZL in ¢/lb → $/bu = price × 11/100), 44 lbs soy meal per bushel (ZM in $/short ton → $/bu = price × 44/2000). All three legs use NoAdjustment for meaningful cross-commodity price levels. Outputs: GPM time series with 20-day SMA, monthly seasonal bar chart, and key stats summary table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN CRUSH SPREAD — GROSS PROCESSING MARGIN (GPM)
# =============================================================================
#
# CBOT Board Crush Formula (standard):
#   GPM ($/bu) = ZL_value + ZM_value - ZS_cost
#
# Unit conversions per bushel of soybeans:
#   Soy Oil  (ZL): 11 lbs × ZL (¢/lb) / 100        → $/bu
#   Soy Meal (ZM): 44 lbs × ZM ($/short ton) / 2000 → $/bu
#   Soybeans (ZS): ZS (¢/bu) / 100                  → $/bu
#
# NoAdjustment used for all three legs — BackwardPanamaCanal accumulates
# different additive shifts per commodity, destroying cross-commodity ratios
# over long histories (D16 skill).
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZS (Soybeans) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zs_price = zs_cont.c   # cents/bushel

# --- Reference: ZL (Soy Oil) ---
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_ref.o, zl_ref.h, zl_ref.l, zl_ref.c, zl_ref.v, zl_ref.oi, zl_ref.s)

zl_price = zl_cont.c   # cents/lb

# --- Reference: ZM (Soy Meal) ---
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_ref.o, zm_ref.h, zm_ref.l, zm_ref.c, zm_ref.v, zm_ref.oi, zm_ref.s)

zm_price = zm_cont.c   # $/short ton

# =============================================================================
# GPM CALCULATION
# =============================================================================
# Oil value:  11 lbs/bu × ZL (¢/lb) / 100  → $/bu
# Meal value: 44 lbs/bu × ZM ($/ton) / 2000 → $/bu
# Bean cost:  ZS (¢/bu) / 100               → $/bu

oil_value  = zl_price * 11.0 / 100.0
meal_value = zm_price * 44.0 / 2000.0
bean_cost  = zs_price / 100.0

gpm = oil_value + meal_value - bean_cost   # $/bushel

# --- 20-day SMA smoothing ---
gpm_sma20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(gpm)

# --- 1-year rolling z-score (how stretched is the current margin?) ---
gpm_zscore = zscore(window=252)(gpm)

# --- Calendar month for seasonal bar ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Key Stats (table first, per narrative arc)
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean Crush Spread — Key Stats',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['GPM ($/bu)', 'Components', 'Z-Score (1Y)'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Period High', 'Period Low'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: GPM
            ColumnSpec(info='Current GPM ($/bu)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period High GPM',     grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period Low GPM',      grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 1: Components (oil value, meal value, bean cost — all current)
            ColumnSpec(info='Oil value ($/bu)',    grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Meal value ($/bu)',   grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Bean cost ($/bu)',    grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Z-score
            ColumnSpec(info='Current 1Y Z-Score',  grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period High Z-Score', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period Low Z-Score',  grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=0
)(gpm, gpm, gpm, oil_value, meal_value, bean_cost, gpm_zscore, gpm_zscore, gpm_zscore)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: GPM Time Series with 20-day SMA
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Is the Processing Margin Wide or Tight?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='GPM ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GPM', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d SMA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(gpm, gpm_sma20))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Monthly Seasonal Bar — Avg GPM by Calendar Month
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Which Months Have the Widest Crush Margins?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg GPM ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=gpm, label=month_num)
